Email

Real email needs an outbound relay. Enter the SMTP settings your relay gave you. The password is stored in a Kubernetes Secret and is never shown again. You can skip this and connect email later.

Stored in a Secret and never shown again.

Mail from your own domain also needs SPF, DKIM and DMARC records at your DNS provider; see the email policy documentation.
